name: UnitConverter
description: Converts metric units to Imperal units and vice versa
summary: "Convert Units" on a message shows it with metric and imperial units swapped

settings.label: My units
settings.description: the units you use and want things converted to. defaults to imperial

notes: A message's hover bar has upstream's Convert Units button (it's also in the right-click menu); the converted text is shown under the message after the conversion icon. "Convert Units" in a message's right-click menu shows the message again under it with its units converted to the ones you use ("My units"), with Dismiss to remove it. Converting to imperial: Celsius, centimeters, meters (as feet and inches), kilometers, km/h, grams and kilograms; to metric: Fahrenheit, feet, inches, 5'11", 5 ft 11 in, pounds, 5 lb 3 oz, ounces and mph. Upstream's arithmetic slips are fixed: inches are multiplied by 2.54 (upstream divides), meters use 3.281 feet (upstream 3.821), "5 lb 3 oz" counts the ounces, 1.75 m reads 5ft8.88in rather than rounding the feet up, and "50 km/h" converts as a speed instead of as "50 km" followed by "/h"; and a number and unit inside a word, such as the "8g" of a Base64 string or the "5 g" of "5 great", are left alone.
